text: Ensembled consultancy averages the results of two single consultancies in which the consultant argues each of the two answers, which the authors say should correct judge calibration errors such as sycophancy or learned misleading persuasion. Double consultancy presents both sets of consultant speeches to the judge in one context for a single explicit comparison, differing from debate in that the two sides never see each other's claims.
title: Ensembled and double consultancy: stronger baselines without refutation between sides
